import sys
from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font

def col_letter(idx):
    letters = ''
    while idx > 0:
        idx, rem = divmod(idx - 1, 26)
        letters = chr(65 + rem) + letters
    return letters

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'sales_data.xlsx'
wb = load_workbook(path)
print("Sheets:", wb.sheetnames)

for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f"\n--- Sheet: {name} (max_row={ws.max_row}, max_col={ws.max_column}) ---")

    header_row = None
    for r in range(1, min(ws.max_row, 20) + 1):
        vals = [ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1)]
        if any(isinstance(v, str) and str(v).strip() for v in vals):
            header_row = r
            break
    if header_row is None:
        print("  no header row found, skipping")
        continue

    headers = {}
    for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1):
        v = ws.cell(row=header_row, column=c).value
        headers[c] = v
        print(f"  col {c}: {v!r}")

    def find_col(kws):
        for c, name in headers.items():
            if name is None:
                continue
            n = str(name).strip().lower()
            if any(k in n for k in kws):
                return c, name
        return None, None

    profit_col, profit_name = find_col(['profit'])
    rev_col, rev_name = find_col(['revenue', 'sales'])
    cost_col, cost_name = find_col(['cost'])

    if rev_col is None or (profit_col is None and cost_col is None):
        print("  no matching profit/revenue columns, skipping")
        continue

    new_col = ws.max_column + 1
    ws.cell(row=header_row, column=new_col, value='Profit Margin (%)')
    ws.cell(row=header_row, column=new_col).font = Font(bold=True)

    if profit_col is not None:
        num_expr = f'{col_letter(profit_col)}{{r}}/{col_letter(rev_col)}{{r}}'
        print(f"  margin = {profit_name} / {rev_name}")
    else:
        num_expr = f'({col_letter(rev_col)}{{r}}-{col_letter(cost_col)}{{r}})/{col_letter(rev_col)}{{r}}'
        print(f"  margin = ({rev_name} - {cost_name}) / {rev_name}")

    count = 0
    for r in range(header_row + 1, ws.max_row + 1):
        has_val = any(ws.cell(row=r, column=c).value is not None for c in range(1, ws.max_column + 1))
        if not has_val:
            continue
        expr = num_expr.format(r=r)
        cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=new_col)
        cell.value = f'=IF({col_letter(rev_col)}{r}=0,"",{expr})'
        cell.number_format = '0.0%'
        count += 1

    print(f"  added column {col_letter(new_col)} 'Profit Margin (%)', {count} data rows")

wb.save(path)
print("\nSaved", path)

import zipfile, re, sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
RNS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'sales_data.xlsx'

def resolve(target):
    if target.startswith('/'):
        return target.lstrip('/')
    if target.startswith('xl/'):
        return target
    return 'xl/' + target

zin = zipfile.ZipFile(path)
names = zin.namelist()
parts = {n: zin.read(n) for n in names}
zin.close()

print("archive entries:", names)

wb_root = ET.fromstring(parts['xl/workbook.xml'])
sheets = [(sh.get('name'), sh.get('{%s}id' % RNS)) for sh in wb_root.iter('{%s}sheet' % NS)]
rels_root = ET.fromstring(parts['xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'])
rid_to_target = {rel.get('Id'): rel.get('Target') for rel in rels_root}

shared = []
ss_name = next((n for n in names if 'sharedStrings' in n), None)
if ss_name:
    ss_root = ET.fromstring(parts[ss_name])
    for si in ss_root.iter('{%s}si' % NS):
        shared.append(''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{%s}t' % NS)))
print("sharedStrings:", shared)

for name, rid in sheets:
    target = resolve(rid_to_target.get(rid, ''))
    print(f"\n[{name}] target={target}")
    raw = parts[target].decode('utf-8', 'replace')
    print("---- raw sheet XML ----")
    print(raw)

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'

zin = zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx')
parts = {n: zin.read(n) for n in zin.namelist()}
zin.close()

root = ET.fromstring(parts['xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'])
row1 = None
for row in root.iter('{%s}row' % NS):
    if row.get('r') == '1':
        row1 = row
        break

for c in row1.iter('{%s}c' % NS):
    t = c.get('t')
    v = c.find('{%s}v' % NS)
    is_ = c.find('{%s}is' % NS)
    txt = None
    if is_ is not None:
        txt = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in is_.iter('{%s}t' % NS))
    print(c.get('r'), 't=', t, 'v=', (v.text if v is not None else None), 'inline=', repr(txt))

print()
print('--- styles.xml ---')
print(parts['xl/styles.xml'].decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
